title: Daily Brief — Morning Edition — Friday, 23 October 2026
description: Emergency patches go out for critical PHP flaws discovered with AI models, Australian government websites briefly go offline during the patching rush, Townsville beekeepers face a chemical-resistant Varroa mite strain, and the Gold Coast council weighs a long-running Coolangatta tower proposal. 한국어로도 브리핑을 전해드립니다.
